desc: In the admin panel, I can monitor and control the server and incoming data.
Here, I funnel together all sources of feedback into one place. Players can leave feedback within the game itself, and my system scrapes Steam reviews and discussion forums daily for anything new.
The in-game feedback system. This is great for getting moment-to-moment thoughts that would otherwise be forgotten or ignored. It also sends the users Save Game, so I can inspect it if needed.

There's also a Discord bot that collects feedback. If anyone tags a message with the 'bug' emoji, the bot will make a feedback item of that message and give it a green checkmark to indicate that it was received.
All feedback can be translated to English, and then promoted to a Planka ticket, or just resolved.
Planka is the self-hosted open source ticket tracking software I use to keep track of issues and feedback I want to act on.
Back in my tool suite, I also collect stack traces from crashes. This is like a mini-Sentry.io, where identical crashes are flattened together and the time is noted.
Next, I can trigger the game to send a Save Game at any point. So if the user gets into a situation I want to understand better, I can trigger a send and load into their game.

In the game, I can also send Metrics events to my database. Then, I run Metabase to visualize that data and get insights about the game. I can attach data like what items people are using. Events can be things like clearing a level, dying, solving a secret, etc...
